description: Land Title Settlement Department - Siyambalanduwa, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720005
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
